segments.text: Day 141 · File sync: delta sync, conflict resolution, versioning।
What: Syncing whole files (Dropbox-style) efficiently by transferring only changed bytes (delta sync), and resolving conflicts when the same file changes on two devices while offline.
How to complete: Design a delta-sync protocol for a large file and describe your conflict resolution policy (e.g.
keep-both-copies) when two offline edits collide.
